headlines.title: Iranian parliament is seeking to pass law allowing the collection of tolls for ships transiting through the Strait of Hormuz
US military says it has now struck 10,000 targets in Iran
The chief of the world's largest asset manager, Larry Fink of BlackRock, tells BBC that if the price of oil 'hits $150 a barrel it will trigger a global recession'.
Some ships have paid as much as $2 million to Iran to safely pass through the Gulf, according to Financial Times report.
